title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
qco_order_name: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2018
scope: This standard covers the technical requirements and methods of test for high strength deformed steel bars and wires produced by thermo-mechanical treatment (TMT) or cold working, for use as reinforcement in concrete in the sizes from 4 mm up to and including 40 mm.

clauses.content: Bars and wires shall be supplied in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600 where 'D' denotes high ductility characterized by higher elongation.

clauses.clause_title: Mechanical Properties of High Strength Deformed Bars
clauses.content: For Fe 500D: Minimum 0.2 percent proof stress/yield stress = 500.0 MPa; Minimum tensile strength = 565.0 MPa (TS/YS ratio >= 1.10); Minimum elongation = 16.0 percent; Total elongation at maximum force = 5.0 percent.
For Fe 500D: Carbon max 0.25%, Sulphur max 0.040%, Phosphorus max 0.040%, Sulphur + Phosphorus max 0.075%, Carbon Equivalent max 0.42%.
Nominal sizes are 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 25, 28, 32, 36, and 40 mm. Mass tolerance on nominal mass per meter ranges from +/- 7% for <= 10mm to +/- 3% for over 16mm.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
scope: This code of practice deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings, structures and civil engineering works. It establishes criteria for design, materials, workmanship, inspection and testing.

clauses.content: Concrete is graded into Ordinary (M10 to M20), Standard (M25 to M55), and High Strength (M60 to M80) based on 28-day characteristic compressive strength in N/mm2.

clauses.clause_title: Minimum Cement Content and Maximum Water-Cement Ratio
clauses.content: Specifies minimum cement content (300 to 360 kg/m3) and maximum water-cement ratio (0.55 down to 0.40) depending on exposure conditions: Mild, Moderate, Severe, Very Severe, Extreme.

Slump requirements: Low workability (25-75 mm) for mass concrete and light RCC slabs; Medium workability (50-100 mm) for heavily reinforced sections; High workability (100-150 mm) for pumped concrete.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification - Part 1: Fly Ash Based
qco_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
scope: This standard covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements for fly ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) produced by intergrinding Portland cement clinker, pozzolana (fly ash), and gypsum or by intimate blending.

clauses.content: Fly ash constituent shall be not less than 15 percent and not more than 35 percent by mass of Portland Pozzolana Cement.
Specific surface (Blaine) shall not be less than 300 m2/kg. Initial setting time shall not be less than 30 minutes; final setting time shall not exceed 600 minutes.
Minimum compressive strength: 72 hours +/- 1 hr: not less than 16 MPa; 168 hours +/- 2 hr: not less than 22 MPa; 672 hours +/- 4 hr: not less than 33 MPa.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (33 Grade, 43 Grade, and 53 Grade)
scope: This standard covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements for Ordinary Portland Cement of 33, 43, and 53 grades. Note that 43 grade (formerly IS 8112) and 53 grade (formerly IS 12269) have now been unified into IS 269:2015.

clauses.content: 28-day minimum compressive strength: 33 Grade: 33 MPa; 43 Grade: 43 MPa (up to 58 MPa); 53 Grade: 53 MPa.
Unaffected by Le Chatelier expansion exceeding 10 mm or autoclave expansion exceeding 0.8%. Initial setting time minimum 30 minutes, final setting time maximum 600 minutes.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Insulated Cables for Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V - Specification
scope: This standard specifies the requirements and test methods for single-core and multi-core PVC insulated and sheathed/unsheathed power cables, flexible cords, and control cables with copper or aluminum conductors for electric power and lighting working voltages up to and including 1100 V AC.

clauses.content: Conductors shall be either high conductivity plain copper or aluminium conforming to IS 8130, solid or stranded, flexible Class 2 or Class 5.
PVC insulation shall be Type A (general purpose, max continuous operating temp 70 deg C), Type C (heat resistant, max 85 deg C), or Type D (for flexible cables).
Cables shall withstand AC test voltage of 3 kV (rms) applied for 5 minutes after immersion in water at 60 deg C without breakdown.
FR / FRLS grade cables must satisfy oxygen index not less than 29% and temperature index not less than 250 deg C.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Specification - Part 1: For Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V
scope: This standard specifies requirements for PVC insulated armored and unarmored heavy duty electric power cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 volts, intended for power distribution and industrial plants.

clauses.content: Armouring shall consist of galvanized round steel wires or galvanized steel strips conforming to IS 3975. Minimum coverage of armouring shall be 90%.
Outer sheath shall be applied by extrusion over the armouring, consisting of black PVC compound conforming to Type ST1 or ST2.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Household and Similar Purposes of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 V and Rated Current up to and Including 16 A - Specification
scope: This standard applies to plugs and fixed or portable socket-outlets for AC only, with or without earthing contact, with a rated voltage not exceeding 250 V and a rated current not exceeding 16 A, intended for household and commercial applications.

clauses.content: Standard ratings are: 2.5 A (2-pin), 6 A / 250 V (3-pin), 10 A / 250 V (3-pin), and 16 A / 250 V (3-pin). Combined 6A/16A universal shutters must meet clearance specs.
Sockets must be designed so that live parts are not accessible when the plug is partially or completely engaged. Mandates child-resistant safety shutters for all domestic sockets.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements - Part 1: Nickel Systems
qco_ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
qco_order_name: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Compulsory Registration Scheme) Order
scope: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable secondary sealed cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes under intended use and reasonably foreseeable misuse.

clauses.content: Fully charged cells and batteries are short-circuited with a resistance < 100 mOhm at 20 deg C and 55 deg C; no fire or explosion permitted.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Safety Requirements - Part 2: Lithium Systems
scope: Specifies requirements and tests for the safe operation of portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries (Lithium-ion, Li-polymer) used in smartphones, laptops, power banks, and portable electronics.

clauses.content: Short-circuit test performed at 55 deg C until case temperature returns to steady state. No explosion or fire.
Battery charged at 2x rated charging current; protective circuit must disconnect charge before hazardous overheating occurs.

title: Horizontal Centrifugal Pumps for Clear, Cold, Fresh Water - Specification
scope: Covers horizontal centrifugal pumps, whether of volute or turbine type, suitable for pumping clear, cold, fresh water with total heads up to 100 meters and delivery sizes up to 150 mm.

clauses.content: Casing: Grade FG 200 Cast Iron conforming to IS 210; Impeller: Leaded bronze Grade LTB 2 of IS 318 or Phosphor bronze or Cast Iron; Shaft: High tensile steel 40C8 of IS 1570.
Pump casing and suction cover shall withstand hydrostatic pressure test of 1.5 times the maximum discharge pressure or 2 times the shut-off head, whichever is higher, held for at least 5 minutes.
Pump overall efficiency must not be less than 95% of guaranteed performance curve at duty point.

title: Industrial Safety Helmets - Specification
qco_order_name: Personal Protective Equipment (Safety Helmets) Quality Control Order, 2021
scope: Specifies physical, performance, and testing requirements for industrial safety helmets intended for use in mining, tunneling, construction, quarrying, shipbuilding, and industrial plants to protect the head from falling objects and impacts.

clauses.content: A 5 kg steel striker dropped from 1 meter height onto the crown of helmet; maximum force transmitted to the headform shall not exceed 5.0 kN.
A 3 kg conical striker dropped from 1 meter shall not make electrical contact with the headform.
Helmets designed for electrical environments must withstand 1.2 kV leakage current test without exceeding 3 mA.

title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Filtering Half Masks to Protect Against Particles - Specification
qco_order_name: Medical Textiles and Respiratory Devices QCO
scope: Specifies minimum requirements for filtering half masks (respirators, e.g. N95/FFP equivalents) used as respiratory protective devices against particles like dust, mists, smoke and bio-aerosols.

clauses.content: Filtering half masks are classified as FFP1 (80% penetration filter efficiency), FFP2 (94% penetration filter efficiency, equivalent to N95), and FFP3 (99% penetration filter efficiency).
For FFP2 masks, the total inward leakage shall not exceed 8% arithmetic mean for 46 out of 50 individual test results.
Inhalation resistance at 30 L/min shall not exceed 0.7 mbar; at 95 L/min shall not exceed 2.4 mbar for FFP2 class.

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings - Specification - Part 1: Steel Tubes
scope: Covers requirements for welded (ERW) and seamless screwed and socketed steel tubes and plain end steel tubes suitable for welding or for screwing to pipe threads conforming to IS 554, applicable for water, gas, steam and air distribution.

clauses.content: Tubes are designated as Light (Class A - Yellow color code), Medium (Class B - Blue color code), and Heavy (Class C - Red color code) based on wall thickness.
Each tube shall be tested at manufacturer's works to a hydrostatic pressure of not less than 5 MPa (50 bar), held for at least 5 seconds without showing any leakage.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements of steel plates, sections (angles, channels, beams, tees), flats, bars and wide flats for use in bridges, buildings, towers, railway rolling stock and general engineering structures.

clauses.content: Steel grades designated as E250, E275, E300, E350, E410, E450, E550, and E650 based on minimum yield strength. Sub-qualities A, BR, B0, C indicate Charpy V-notch impact test temperatures.
Grade E250 (Quality A): Minimum yield strength = 250 MPa (for thickness < 20mm), Tensile strength = 410 MPa, Minimum elongation = 23%.

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
qco_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and testing for packaged drinking water, water derived from any source of potable water subjected to treatments like filtration, demineralization, reverse osmosis, aeration, and disinfection.

clauses.content: TDS max 500 mg/L (min 75 mg/L after remineralization); pH range 6.5 to 8.5; Turbidity max 2 NTU; Total hardness as CaCO3 max 200 mg/L.
Escherichia coli, Coliform bacteria, Faecal streptococci, Pseudomonas aeruginosa shall be absent in any 250 mL sample.

title: Disinfectant Fluids, Phenolic Type - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of test for phenolic disinfectant fluids, black fluids and white fluids, used for general sanitation, hospital disinfection and industrial floors.

clauses.content: Classified into Black fluids (Class A and B) and White fluids (Class A and B). Grades based on Rideal-Walker (RW) coefficient from Grade 1 (RW min 18) to Grade 3 (RW min 5).

title: Liquid Hand Wash - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for liquid hand wash used for general cleansing and sanitizing of hands.

clauses.content: Total active matter shall be not less than 10.0 percent by mass; pH of 10% aqueous solution shall be between 5.5 and 8.0; Foam height min 100 mm.

title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks - Specification
scope: Covers dimensions, compressive strength, water absorption, efflorescence and warpage requirements for common burnt clay building bricks used in masonry construction.

clauses.content: Bricks classified from Class 35 (min 35 N/mm2) down to Class 3.5 (min 3.5 N/mm2). Standard modular dimensions: 190 mm x 90 mm x 90 mm.
Water absorption after 24 hr immersion in cold water shall not exceed 20 percent by weight for bricks up to Class 12.5 and 15 percent for higher classes.

title: Fortified Rice Kernels (FRK) - Specification
sectional_committee: FAD 16 (Foodgrains, Starches and Ready to Eat Foods)
qco_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
qco_order_name: Fortified Rice Kernels (Quality Control & Compulsory Certification) Mandate
scope: Prescribes requirements, methods of sampling and test for Fortified Rice Kernels (FRK) produced through extrusion technology, blended with normal milled rice at a ratio of 1:100 for distribution under Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS), PM POSHAN, and ICDS welfare schemes.

clauses.content: FRK shall be manufactured from broken rice grains ground into flour, blended with micronutrient premix (Ferric Pyrophosphate/Sodium Iron EDTA, Folic Acid, and Vitamin B12) using hot extrusion technology.
Iron: 280 to 425 mg/100g; Folic Acid: 750 to 1250 mcg/100g; Vitamin B12: 7.5 to 12.5 mcg/100g. When blended at 1:100 ratio, 1 kg fortified rice provides 28 to 42.5 mg iron.
Moisture content shall not exceed 12.0 percent by mass. Grain length shall closely match conventional rice (between 5.0 mm and 7.5 mm), with true density between 1.30 and 1.50 g/cm3.

title: Wheat Atta - Specification
qco_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for wheat atta (whole meal and partially debranned) for human consumption, widely procured by state food civil supplies corporations for ration shops.

clauses.content: Wheat atta shall be obtained by milling sound, clean wheat grains. It shall be free from grit, rancidity, insect infestation, and artificial coloring matter.
Moisture max 13.0%; Total ash on dry basis max 2.0%; Acid insoluble ash on dry basis max 0.15%; Gluten dry basis min 7.0%; Alcoholic acidity max 0.18%.

title: Textiles - Jute Bags for Packing 50 kg Foodgrains - Specification
qco_ministry: Ministry of Textiles & Department of Food & Public Distribution
qco_order_name: Jute Packaging Materials (Compulsory Use in Packing Commodities) Order
scope: Prescribes constructional details and requirements of lightweight B.Twill jute bags for packing 50 kg foodgrains (wheat and paddy) procured by the Food Corporation of India (FCI) and State Procuring Agencies.

clauses.content: Outside length: 940 mm (+20/-10 mm); Outside width: 570 mm (+20/-10 mm); Nominal mass of bag: 580 grams (+/- 6%).
Breaking strength: Warp min 320 N; Weft min 350 N; Seam strength along side and bottom min 240 N.
Jute bags must be manufactured using non-mineral batching oil (vegetable oil based) with unsaponifiable hydrocarbon content <= 1250 mg/kg to prevent contamination of edible grain.

title: Iodized Salt (Vacuum Evaporated) - Specification
qco_ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution / FSSAI
qco_order_name: Iodized Salt (Quality Control & Public Distribution) Order
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for vacuum evaporated iodized salt used for direct human consumption, institutional feeding, and PDS welfare distribution.

clauses.content: Sodium Chloride (NaCl) on dry basis min 99.0%; Iodine content at manufacturing level min 30 ppm (min 15 ppm at distribution level); Water insoluble matter max 0.05%.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
scope: Covers chemical and physical requirements and methods of test for coarse aggregate, fine aggregate (natural sand, crushed stone sand, manufactured sand), and all-in aggregate for use in concrete.

clauses.content: Aggregates are classified into Natural Aggregate, Manufactured Aggregate (M-Sand), and Recycled Concrete Aggregate (RCA).
Specifies passing percentages for 4.75mm, 2.36mm, 1.18mm, 600 micron, 300 micron, and 150 micron across Grading Zones I, II, III, and IV.

title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice
scope: Provides criteria for design and construction of steel structures using Limit State Method (LSM) for hot rolled steel sections and plate girders in industrial buildings, bridges, and infrastructure.

clauses.content: Structures shall be designed by limit state method for Limit State of Strength and Limit State of Serviceability.

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply - Specification
qco_order_name: Polyethylene Pipes and Fittings (Quality Control) Order
scope: Prescribes requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes made from PE 63, PE 80, and PE 100 materials for water supply for domestic and industrial purposes.

clauses.content: Pipes shall be manufactured from carbon black compound PE 63, PE 80, or PE 100 with density >= 940 kg/m3.

title: Centrifugally Cast (Spun) Iron Pressure Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage - Specification
qco_order_name: Ductile and Cast Iron Pipes QCO
scope: Covers centrifugally cast ductile and grey iron pressure pipes with socket and spigot ends or flanged ends for transmitting water, gas and sewage.

clauses.content: Pipes classified into Class K7, K9, and K12 based on wall thickness and working pressure.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated PVC Sheathed Cables - Specification - Part 1: For Working Voltage Up to and Including 1100 V
scope: Specifies requirements for crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated and PVC sheathed armored and unarmored power cables for voltages up to 1100 V.

clauses.content: Conductors shall be Class 2 stranded aluminum or copper conforming to IS 8130.
Insulation shall be cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) applied by extrusion, rated for 90 deg C continuous operating temperature.

title: Outdoor Type Oil-Immersed Distribution Transformers Up to and Including 2500 kVA, 33 kV - Specification
scope: Covers outdoor type oil immersed distribution transformers up to 2500 kVA and 33 kV with standard energy efficiency star ratings (Energy Level 1, 2, and 3).

clauses.content: Specifies maximum total losses at 50% and 100% loading for Energy Level 1, 2, and 3 to ensure BEE energy efficiency compliance.

title: Electrical Accessories - Circuit-Breakers for Overcurrent Protection for Household and Similar Installations (MCBs)
scope: Applies to AC air-break miniature circuit-breakers (MCBs) for operation at 50 Hz, with rated voltage <= 440 V and rated current <= 125 A, with rated breaking capacity up to 10,000 A.

clauses.content: Standard instantaneous tripping curves designated as Type B (3 In to 5 In), Type C (5 In to 10 In), and Type D (10 In to 20 In).

title: Safety of Power Converters for Use in Photovoltaic Power Systems - Part 2: Particular Requirements for Inverters
qco_ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
qco_order_name: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order
scope: Provides safety requirements for grid-connected and off-grid utility-interconnected solar photovoltaic inverters converting DC solar array power to AC electricity.

clauses.content: Grid-connected solar inverters must automatically disconnect within 2 seconds upon loss of main grid power to prevent hazardous islanding.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1: Safety Requirements
qco_order_name: Compulsory Registration Scheme for LED Lighting
scope: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps for domestic and similar general lighting services with rated wattage up to 60 W and voltage up to 250 V.

clauses.content: Insulation resistance shall not be less than 4 MOhm, and lamp must withstand high voltage dielectric test.

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
qco_order_name: Electronics and Information Technology Goods Compulsory Registration Order
scope: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including personal computers, laptops, servers, printers, displays, scanners, and data storage systems.

clauses.content: Components such as power supply modules, capacitors, and transformers must meet fire hazard and thermal limits.

title: Mobile Phone Handsets - Part 3: Language Support for Indian Languages
qco_order_name: Indian Language Support for Mobile Handsets Mandate
scope: Specifies Indian language support requirements for all mobile phone handsets sold or procured in India, mandating display and input support for all 22 official Indian languages.

clauses.content: Handset must render message reading and text entry in English, Hindi, and at least one official regional language.

title: Electric Monobloc Pumpsets for Clear, Cold, Fresh Water - Specification
scope: Covers electric monobloc centrifugal pumpsets where pump and motor form an integral compact unit for agricultural and drinking water supply with total heads up to 90 meters.

clauses.content: Overall efficiency shall comply with prescribed minimum values based on rated power (kW) and specific speed.

title: Submersible Pumpsets for Clear, Cold, Fresh Water - Specification
scope: Covers design, manufacturing and performance testing of multistage submersible centrifugal pumpsets for deep tube-wells and borewells.

clauses.content: Pump bowl and discharge casing shall withstand test pressure of 1.5 times maximum shut-off head for 5 minutes.

title: Code for Unfired Pressure Vessels
scope: Specifies design, material selection, fabrication, inspection and testing of unfired fusion-welded pressure vessels for chemical, petroleum, and power plants.

clauses.content: Pressure vessels classified into Class I (fully radiographed), Class II (spot radiographed), and Class III (visual inspection only).

title: Galvanized Steel Sheets (Plain and Corrugated) - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements for zinc-coated galvanized plain and corrugated steel sheets and coils used for roofing, cladding, and packaging.

clauses.content: Coating designations range from 120 g/m2 up to 450 g/m2 total both sides.

title: Paving Bitumen - Specification
division_name: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division
qco_ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
scope: Covers viscosity graded paving bitumen (VG 10, VG 20, VG 30, VG 40) used in road construction, highway pavements, and airport runways.

clauses.content: For VG 30: Absolute viscosity at 60 deg C = 2400 to 3600 Poises; Kinematic viscosity at 135 deg C min 350 cSt; Penetration at 25 deg C = 45; Softening point min 47 deg C.

title: Automotive Diesel Fuel - Specification (Bharat Stage VI)
division_name: Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division
qco_ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
scope: Specifies requirements for high speed diesel (HSD) fuel conforming to Bharat Stage VI (BS-VI) automotive emission norms with ultra-low sulphur content.

clauses.content: Sulphur content maximum 10 mg/kg (10 ppm); Cetane index minimum 46 (Cetane number min 51); Flash point min 35 deg C; Density at 15 deg C = 820 to 845 kg/m3.

title: Surgical Rubber Gloves - Specification
qco_ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / CDSCO
scope: Specifies dimensions, tensile strength, elongation, pinhole freedom and water tightness requirements for sterile, packaged disposable surgical rubber gloves.

clauses.content: Tensile strength before accelerated aging shall not be less than 24.0 MPa; Ultimate elongation min 750%.

title: Breathing Apparatus - Specification - Part 2: Open Circuit Self-Contained Compressed Air Breathing Apparatus
scope: Specifies minimum requirements for open-circuit compressed air self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA) used by fire fighters and chemical response teams.

clauses.content: Apparatus must supply min 300 L/min of air without negative pressure developing inside face piece.

title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grade C - Part 1: Hexagon Head Bolts (Size Range M5 to M64)
scope: Specifies characteristics of hexagon head bolts with metric threads from M5 to M64 of product grade C for general engineering and construction assemblies.

clauses.content: Fasteners shall conform to property classes 4.6, 5.6, or 8.8 as specified in IS 1367 (Part 3).

title: Aluminium Phosphide Formulations - Specification
qco_ministry: Ministry of Agriculture / Central Insecticides Board
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of test for aluminium phosphide tablet and pellet formulations used for grain fumigation in FCI silos and CWC warehouses against pests.

clauses.content: Each 3.0 g tablet shall release not less than 1.0 g of phosphine gas (PH3) upon exposure to atmospheric moisture.

title: Copper Alloy Gate, Globe and Check Valves for Water Works Purposes - Specification
scope: Covers copper alloy (bronze and brass) gate valves, globe valves and check valves suitable for water works pipelines with working pressures up to 1.6 MPa.

clauses.content: Body test pressure shall be 1.5 times the maximum rated working pressure, held for 2 minutes without leakage.

title: Recommendation for Estimation of Flow of Water in Open Channels - Part 1: Velocity Area Methods
scope: Lays down recommendations for estimating flow velocity and discharge of water in rivers, irrigation canals and open channels using current meters and float methods.

clauses.content: Specifies two-point method (0.2 and 0.8 depth) and one-point method (0.6 depth) for determining mean vertical velocity.

title: Quality Management Systems - Requirements
scope: Specifies requirements for a quality management system (QMS) when an organization needs to demonstrate its ability to consistently provide products and services that meet customer and applicable statutory requirements.

clauses.clause_title: Control of Externally Provided Processes, Products and Services
clauses.content: The organization shall ensure that externally provided processes, products and services conform to requirements and do not adversely affect quality.

title: Environmental Management Systems - Requirements with Guidance for Use
scope: Specifies requirements for an environmental management system that an organization can use to enhance its environmental performance, fulfill compliance obligations, and achieve environmental objectives.

clauses.content: Organization shall determine environmental aspects of activities, products and services that it can control.

title: Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems - Requirements with Guidance for Use
scope: Specifies requirements for an occupational health and safety (OH&S) management system to enable organizations to provide safe and healthy workplaces, prevent work-related injury and ill health.

clauses.content: Organization shall establish processes for the elimination of hazards and reduction of OH&S risks.

title: Textiles - Jute Bags for Packing 50 kg Sugar - Specification
qco_order_name: Jute Packaging Materials (Compulsory Use in Packing Commodities) Mandate
scope: Prescribes constructional details and requirements of lightweight B.Twill jute bags for packing 50 kg sugar produced by sugar mills for central pool and PDS allocation.

clauses.content: Outside length: 910 mm; Outside width: 560 mm; Mass: 580 g.

title: Geosynthetics - Polypropylene Nonwoven Geotextiles for Highways - Specification
scope: Covers mechanical, hydraulic, and endurance requirements of polypropylene nonwoven needle-punched geotextiles used in subgrade separation and stabilization of roads and expressways.

clauses.content: Trapezoidal tear strength min 250 N; CBR puncture resistance min 1500 N; Apparent opening size (AOS) <= 150 microns.

title: Specification for Bleaching Powder, Stable
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for stable bleaching powder (chlorinated lime) for water treatment, public health sanitation and municipal disinfection.

clauses.content: Available chlorine shall be not less than 32.0 percent by mass; Moisture max 0.3%.

title: Adhesives for Use with Ceramic, Mosaic and Stone Tiles - Specification
scope: Specifies chemical and physical requirements for polymer-modified cementitious adhesives used for fixing ceramic, vitrified and natural stone tiles.

clauses.content: Classified into Type 1 (standard tile adhesive), Type 2 (for heavy vitreous tiles), Type 3 (for external facade), and Type 4 (for dry wall installation).

title: Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures - Part 1: General Provisions and Buildings
scope: Provides criteria for calculating design seismic forces for buildings and structures located in Seismic Zones II, III, IV, and V across India.

clauses.content: Calculates horizontal design seismic coefficient Ah using zone factor Z, importance factor I, and response reduction factor R.

title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces - Code of Practice
scope: Covers requirements for designing and detailing of members of reinforced concrete structures required to resist earthquake effects through high ductility.

clauses.content: Minimum longitudinal steel ratio shall be not less than 0.24 sqrt(fck)/fy; both top and bottom bars shall extend into column.

title: Concrete Masonry Units - Specification - Part 1: Hollow and Solid Concrete Blocks
scope: Covers solid and hollow precast concrete blocks for use in load bearing and non-load bearing masonry construction.

clauses.content: Specifies minimum average compressive strength of hollow blocks from 3.5 MPa to 15.0 MPa based on grade.

title: Methods of Measurement of Building and Civil Engineering Works - Part 1: Earthwork
scope: Prescribes standard methods of measurement for earthwork excavation, trenching, backfilling and leveling in civil engineering contracts and tenders.

clauses.content: Classifies soils for excavation payment into Ordinary Soil, Hard Soil, Soft Rock, and Hard Rock requiring blasting.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Applies to electrical installation earthing systems for power generation, transmission, industrial plants, commercial and domestic buildings to ensure safety against electric shock and equipment damage.

clauses.content: Specifies design of rod electrodes, pipe electrodes (min 38mm dia GI pipe), and plate electrodes (600x600mm copper or GI plate) embedded in soil with bentonite or charcoal/salt backfill.

title: Power Transformers - Part 1: General
scope: Specifies requirements for three-phase and single-phase power transformers (including auto-transformers) used in transmission and industrial power grids.

clauses.content: Specifies ONAN, ONAF, and OFAF cooling methods and temperature rise limits for oil and windings.

title: Residual Current Operated Circuit-Breakers (RCCBs) - Part 1: Without Integral Overcurrent Protection for Household Installations
scope: Applies to residual current operated circuit-breakers (RCCB / ELCB) for protecting human life against electrocution and electrical fire hazards.

clauses.content: Standard rated residual operating currents (I Delta n) are 10 mA, 30 mA, 100 mA, 300 mA, and 500 mA. 30 mA mandated for direct human contact protection.

title: Line Operated Three-Phase A.C. Motors (IE Code) - Energy Efficient Motors - Specification
scope: Specifies energy efficiency classes (IE2, IE3, and IE4) for three-phase squirrel cage induction motors from 0.12 kW up to 1000 kW operating at 50 Hz.

clauses.content: Defines strict minimum percentage full-load efficiency across 2-pole, 4-pole, 6-pole and 8-pole ratings for IE2 and premium IE3 classes.

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
qco_order_name: Electronics & IT Goods Compulsory Registration Order
scope: Applies to electronic apparatus designed to be fed from mains, supplying power, or battery for reception, generation, recording or reproduction of audio and video.

clauses.content: Apparatus must operate without hazard under normal operation and under single fault condition.

title: Covered Electrodes for Manual Metal Arc Welding of Carbon and Carbon Manganese Steel - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for covered electrodes for manual metal arc welding of mild, normal and medium tensile structural steels.

clauses.content: Classified by 6-letter designation representing tensile strength, yield stress, elongation, impact values, flux coating and welding position.

title: Carbon Steel Cast Billet Ingots, Billets, Blooms and Slabs for Re-Rolling into Steel for General Structural Purposes - Specification
scope: Covers chemical and physical requirements of continuously cast carbon steel billets, blooms and slabs used for re-rolling into TMT bars and structural sections.

clauses.content: Specifies strict maximum limits for Carbon, Manganese, Phosphorus (max 0.050%) and Sulphur (max 0.050%).

title: Specification for Performance Requirements for Constant Speed Compression Ignition (Diesel) Engines for Agricultural and Industrial Use
scope: Specifies performance, fuel consumption, governor characteristics and testing requirements for single cylinder constant speed diesel engines up to 20 kW.

clauses.content: Specific fuel consumption at rated continuous output shall not exceed manufacturer guaranteed value by more than 5%.

title: Packaged Air Conditioners - Specification
scope: Prescribes constructional and performance requirements for factory-assembled packaged air conditioners with water-cooled or air-cooled condensers.

clauses.content: Total cooling capacity shall not be less than 95% of rated capacity at standard rating conditions.

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
qco_order_name: Natural Mineral Water Compulsory Certification Order
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of test for packaged natural mineral water obtained directly from natural subterranean or spring sources.

clauses.content: Total dissolved solids between 150 mg/L and 700 mg/L naturally derived without demineralization.

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders - Specification
qco_ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
scope: Specifies requirements regarding construction, materials, shock absorption, retention system, and penetration resistance for two-wheeler protective helmets.

clauses.content: Peak acceleration imparted to headform shall not exceed 300 g at any impact test site.

title: Hypodermic Syringes for Single Use - Part 1: Sterile Medical Syringes
scope: Prescribes requirements for sterile single-use hypodermic syringes made of plastic or glass for aspiration and injection of fluids.

clauses.content: No leakage past piston and seal shall occur under 300 kPa internal hydrostatic pressure.

title: Handloom Cotton Bed Sheets - Specification
scope: Prescribes constructional particulars and other performance requirements for grey, scoured, bleached, dyed, striped, checked or printed handloom and powerloom cotton bed sheets used in hospitals and institutions.

clauses.content: Dimensions as specified; Mass per unit area min 140 g/m2; Breaking strength warp min 350 N, weft min 300 N; Thread count min 180 TC.
Whiteness index min 80%; Dimensional shrinkage after wash not exceeding 3.0% warp and 2.0% weft; Colour fastness rating min 4.
